dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the maximum mid-section width toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with minimal intensity variation across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Localized low-density grey pixel clusters visible near the anterior blowhole and posterior peduncle.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the white baseline and minor pigmented areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Visible thin, linear, low-contrast marks across the mid-dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple faint linear marks on the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark blowhole orifice located on the anterior dorsal plane.
